display_long_description:
Napoli Sotterranea VR invites you to discover the hidden underground world of Naples in an immersive virtual reality experience.

Journey beneath the historic city center through ancient tunnels, water reservoirs, and archaeological spaces that reveal centuries of history. The tour includes 23 interconnected 360° environments, culminating in the extraordinary Theatre of Nero — one of the most fascinating Roman sites hidden beneath the city.

The experience begins with a free preview of the first environments, allowing you to explore and experience the atmosphere before unlocking the complete tour. The full journey lasts approximately 40 minutes and can be accessed through a one-time in-app purchase.

Designed for comfort and immersion, the experience supports both natural Hand Tracking interaction and Meta Quest Touch controllers.

Step below the streets of Naples and experience history from a unique perspective.
